confidence_notes: Food anchors use recent Kandy cost indexes, some updated after July 2026, so they are current proxies rather than a measured July snapshot. Cocktail pricing is supported by a current index; wine by the glass is estimated from its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with greater uncertainty, not based on live booking listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external city comparator used: food anchors use Kandy price data, while accommodation reflects general patterns for hostels and guesthouses in inland Sri Lankan tourist towns.
